title: Multi-target triage & prioritization
description: Adaptive workflow to handle 10s-100s of targets without thrash.
detail: 1) Normalize scope (IPs, CIDRs, domains, apps) and de-dup. 2) Fast liveness/port sweep (masscan/nmap top ports) -> bucket by exposure (internet-facing mgmt, auth portals, ICS ports, crown jewels). 3) Fingerprint services (httpx/whatweb/nmap -sV) and tag tech/role. 4) Prioritize: exposed admin/VPN/ICS + weak auth + known high-impact vulns first; schedule deep dives. 5) Track per-target state as facts (host,service,finding) in the campaign graph; keep frontier focused (WIP limit). 6) Re-scan deltas, not everything. Safety: respect rate limits and authorized scope; avoid disruptive scans on fragile ICS/medical/OT unless explicitly approved.
